name: Instantaneous overcurrent
summary: An overcurrent function without an intentional operating time delay in its instantaneous application.
description: An instantaneous overcurrent function detects current above its operating criteria without an intentional time delay in the instantaneous application. Actual operating time, implementation and any combined 50/51 labelling are documented by the manufacturer.

On a power drawing, keep this function reference connected to the selected equipment and its complete designation. A multifunction relay can implement several numbered functions. This entry explains the reference; it supplies no settings or commissioning procedure.
readingNotes: Identify phase, residual or another measurement from the full designation.
Separate the function reference from pickup and other settings.
drawingChecklist: Reference CT or other current inputs.
Identify the protected circuit and relay.
distinction: Instantaneous does not mean zero physical operating time. A 50 label does not supply pickup values or prove coordination with other protection.
